intro: Between late April and mid-May 2026, ZCyberNews tracked 13 articles on the npm ecosystem, with eight rated critical and four high. The threat actors TeamPCP, CanisterSprawl, and mini Shai-Hulud were observed targeting software development, technology, AI, automation, and cloud services globally. Key vulnerabilities included CVE-2026-41650 and CVE-2026-44664, each carrying a CVSS score of 6.1. One medium-severity incident was also recorded during this period.
